name: MLVU
description: A comprehensive benchmark for multi-task long video understanding that evaluates multimodal large language models on videos ranging from 3 minutes to 2 hours across 9 distinct tasks including reasoning, captioning, recognition, and summarization.
reputation: Comprehensive long video understanding benchmark; tests multimodal LLMs on extended video content
notes: Evaluates multi-task long video understanding with videos ranging from 3 minutes to 2 hours. Includes reasoning, captioning, recognition, and summarization tasks.
